articles.title: SZA Pops Up at Don Toliver’s NYC Show — and the Crowd Goes Wild!
articles.summary: At Madison Square Garden, SZA surprised everyone by joining Don Toliver to sing their song “Used.” She told the crowd she might be his biggest fan. Other stars like Peso Pluma and Sheck Wes also showed up.

articles.title: Want Cool, Vintage-Style Photos? These Cameras Are Under $100!
articles.summary: Digital cameras are making a huge comeback, and you don’t need to spend a lot. There are great ones under $100 that give photos a cool, old-school look — like the Camp Snap, which has no screen, just like a disposable camera from the ’90s.

articles.title: Guess Who’s the Top Country Songwriter of All Time? It’s Not Who You Think!
articles.summary: A new book ranked the best country songwriters ever, and the top two are modern hitmakers Ashley Gorley and Shane McAnally — not legends like Willie Nelson. They’ve written tons of songs you’ve probably heard on the radio.
